Alpha_inf.dat.file_order: iTR outer, iTmRatio middle, column l inner

columns.2: Alpha_2s for Tm/Tr > 1 using reciprocal ratio
columns.3: Alpha_2p for Tm/Tr > 1 using reciprocal ratio

Alpha_inf.dat.interpolation: four-point cubic interpolation of logarithms in both log(Tr) and the linear temperature-ratio coordinate

R_inf.dat.interpolation: four-point cubic interpolation of logarithms in log(Tr)

derived_rates.Alpha_eq: columns 0/1 evaluated at Tm/Tr=1; used for photoionization

columns.2: A2s_tab: dLambda_2s/dE DeltaE below Ly-alpha; dK_2s/dE DeltaE above Ly-alpha
columns.3: A3s3d_tab: (dLambda_3s/dE + 5 dLambda_3d/dE) DeltaE below Ly-beta; aggregate Raman rate above Ly-beta
columns.4: A4s4d_tab: (dLambda_4s/dE + 5 dLambda_4d/dE) DeltaE or its aggregate continuation

virtual_state_table.normalization: sub-Ly-alpha A2s entries are renormalized so their sum equals Lambda_2s1s=8.2206 s^-1
virtual_state_table.native_use: 2s/2p real states and 311 virtual photon states are assembled into a sparse block including two-photon/Raman and Ly-alpha diffusion

mode_policy.FULL: canonical source for Full Bianchi-HyRec: retains numerical radiation field, virtual states, diffusion, and two-photon/Raman
mode_policy.SWIFT: not a microphysical anisotropic kernel; compresses FULL transfer into a fitted correction to the scalar Ly-alpha escape rate
